test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: By selling an article at Rs.425, a shopkeeper had a loss of 15%. At what price should he sell the article so as to make a profit of 20%?
solution:
**Given:-**

 The initial selling price = Rs. 425

Loss = 15%

Required profit = 20% 

**Formula used:-**

C.P. = 100/(100 - Loss%) × S.P.

S.P. = (100 + Profit%)/100 × C.P.
